SELECT d.* FROM t_seatunnel_web_datasource d WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_seatunnel_web_lake_ods_database_binding b WHERE b.source_data_source_id = d.id AND b.resource_status = #{resourceStatus} AND b.deleted = 0 ) AND (d.system_managed = FALSE OR d.system_managed IS NULL)
AND d.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY d.create_time DESC, d.id DESC
